title: Asus ROG Gladius III Gaming Mouse P514 - New - Sealed - Republic Of Gamers
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Keyboards, Mice & Pointers:Mice, Trackballs & Touchpads
descriptionText: The Asus ROG Gladius III Gaming Mouse P514 is a high-quality wired mouse designed specifically for gaming enthusiasts. With its sleek black color and Republic Of Gamers branding, this mouse is sure to appeal to those looking for a reliable and stylish accessory for their gaming setup. The mouse offers a comfortable design and precise USB connectivity, making it a great choice for gamers who want a smooth and responsive gaming experience.
